**The biggest red flag is 8 haul trucks at high failure risk today, which sits behind both the 2.6-percentage-point drop in fleet availability (89.3% in Q1 FY2027 vs. 91.2% in Q4 FY2026) and the USD 1.17/t rise in C1 cash cost (USD 21.33/t vs. USD 20.16/t, +5.8%).** The fleet telemetry gave us 7.3 days' warning on average before all 74 failures last quarter, yet lost downtime cost 6.73 Mt—worth USD 177 M of revenue—because only 24.2% of down-hours made it into SAP maintenance notifications.

| Metric | Value | Change | Provenance | Source |
|--------|-------|--------|------------|--------|
| C1 cost | USD 21.33/t | +5.8% | MIXED | Stand-in cost postings; processing historian |
| Fleet availability | 89.3% | -1.9 pp | OPS | Fleet management system |
| Trucks at high risk | 8 trucks | today | OPS | Fleet telemetry, TPMS |
| Lost tonnes (Q1) | 6.73 Mt | worth USD 177M | MIXED | FMS downtime; SAP notifications; stand-in price |
| Spares exposed | 2 parts | first out 01 Dec 2026 | SAP_STANDIN | MaterialStock, supplier alerts |
| EBITDA | USD 80.44/t | +USD 4.51/t | MIXED | Stand-in BillingDocument, cost postings; operations |

**Recommendation:** Intervene *today* on the 8 high-risk trucks using the telemetry risk scores—schedule predictive maintenance or pull them offline before they fail—and ensure every down-hour from the FMS automatically raises a notification so cost and lost-tonne visibility is complete.

---
**Sources**  
*OPS (fleet telemetry, FMS, historian):* Fleet availability, trucks at risk, downtime hours, failure warnings  
*MIXED (SAP BDC + operations + stand-in):* C1 cost, lost tonnes, revenue at risk, EBITDA  
*SAP_STANDIN:* Spares exposed  

*All data are simulated for a fictional operation.*
